{addr}! It's {who}. I'm at the {hospital} ER, my phone broke. Send {amount} by {wallet} NOW. Don't tell {other}!
A voice clone! AI can copy a voice from a short clip. "Keep it secret" is a scam trick.
{addr}, {who} here. The doctor says I need an operation tonight. Please send {amount} on {wallet} right now. Hurry!
Scammers fake hospital emergencies to rush you. A real family member can wait while you call back.
Hello {addr}, {who} here. I'm in the {hospital} ER and need a deposit for the bed. Please send {amount} on {wallet}. I'll explain later.
A calm voice can be cloned too. Hospital bills are paid at the hospital, not by wallet.
{addr}, it's {who} on a new number, my phone fell in water. I need {amount} on {wallet} for medicine at the pharmacy. Keep it between us.
"New number" plus "keep it between us" is a classic. Call the saved number or ask another relative.
{addr}, it's {who}. I'm in the {hospital} ER. They will not treat me until I pay {amount}. Send it to {wallet}, please.
Real emergency rooms treat first. Pressure to pay by wallet right now is the red flag.
{addr}, it's {who}. I twisted my ankle and I'm at the {hospital}. I'm short {amount} for the X-ray. Can you send it? Call me back if you like.
A real family call can ask for money, and it welcomes your check. Calling back and asking proved it.
{addr}, {who} here. I'm borrowing a nurse's phone, mine died. I have a fever and they want me to stay overnight. Please bring my blanket tomorrow.
A borrowed phone is no proof either way. The other checks agreed, so this was a real call.
{addr}, it's {who}. I'm okay, it's only a sprain. I'm at the health center. Can you pick me up at 5? No need to send any money.
A real call with no money asked. A quick check is still kind, and your family will understand.
{addr}, {who}. The health center check-up is done, and my medicine costs {amount}. Can you send it on {wallet}? I'll pay you back on Sunday.
A real request can look just like a scam. Only the checks tell them apart: never trust the voice alone.
Hi {addr}, it's {who}. They are keeping me at the {hospital} for tests. Please don't worry. Can you bring my glasses and ID?
A calm, real call. Checking took a moment, and it let you help the right way.
Dr. Alcantara from {clinic}. Your lab results are critical! Pay a release fee of {amount} on {wallet} within the hour, or we close your file.
Real clinics do not charge a "release fee" by e-wallet. Call your health center on its official number.
Hello! Dr. Alcantara here. Stop your maintenance medicine, it is poison. My herbal capsules cure it all. Send {amount} on {wallet} for a box.
Never stop prescribed medicine because of a call or an ad. Ask your own doctor or health worker.
Good day, from {clinic}. To hold your child's vaccine slot, send a booking fee of {amount} to {wallet} today. Slots are almost gone.
Routine child vaccines at the health center are free. Call the health center to check.
Good day, this is the nurse at {clinic}. Reminder: your baby's vaccine is on Friday, 9 AM. It is free. Please bring the health card.
A real health center reminder asks for no fee. Vaccines at the health center are free.
Hello, {clinic} here. Your mother's blood pressure check is on Thursday. Please bring her medicine list. No payment needed. Call us to confirm.
A real clinic call asks you to bring papers, not to send money. Confirming through the clinic is safe.
This is Dr. Alcantara at {clinic}. Your follow-up visit is next month. Please bring your health card. There is no fee to book it.
Real clinics confirm visits and take no wallet fees. Calling them back is always okay.
Banko Liwanag security! Your account is locked. Read me the 6-digit code we just texted you so we can unlock it. Quick!
A real bank never asks for your OTP or PIN. Hang up and call the number on your card.
Good day from Banko Liwanag. A strange payment left your account. To cancel it, tell me your PIN and move your money to a safe account.
Banks do not ask you to move money to a "safe account". Call the number on your card.
